Requirement: The supplier shall assemble paint protection sleeving on braided leads using an alternative method where one end overlaps the braid by 30±5 mm and is secured with three wraps of vinyl adhesive tape, provided written authorization from the harness assembly design control is obtained or it is used for repairing damaged sleeving.
IT: Quando requerido na tabua de montagem, componentes a aplicar por cima da manga (clips, abraçadeiras ou marcações de cor), é mandatório aplicar uma bandagem por baixo destes, estendendo a bandagem 10 a 15mm para cada lado.
Analysis: The specific overlap length of 30±5 mm and securing with three wraps of vinyl adhesive tape are not explicitly stated in the IT. The IT only references a bandage extending 10–15 mm on each side (not overlapping the braid) and does not mention the three-wrap tape method.
action: Update WI 3600-11 to explicitly include the customer’s requirement: overlap of **30±5 mm** with **three wraps of vinyl adhesive tape**, ensuring alignment with the customer’s specifications. Verify that written authorization or repair use conditions are also addressed in the IT.

action: Update IT 3404-11 to explicitly include steps for validating all wire combinations and heat shrink seals during electrical testing, as required by the customer. Add specific procedures for testing these elements when different wire sizes/combinations are used.

action: Update IT WI 3404-11 to explicitly include the immersion, air pressure test, and bubble visibility checks as described in the customer requirement (Caterpillar 1E2358 p.50). Add detailed steps for these actions under the electrical test procedure.

title: Contradicting requirements: JDS-G223 p.45 vs JDS-G223X3 p.4
detail:

JDS-G223 p.45: The supplier shall obtain approval from the John Deere Quality Representative.
action: Clarify with the customer which document prevails.

Analysis: spiral taping under conduit tube; spot tape coverage of min. 20 mm on both sides of tube opening
action: Update IT WI 3326-11 to explicitly include 'spiral taping under the conduit tube' and 'spot tape covering a minimum of 20 mm on both sides of the tube opening' as required by the customer's DLW25046 specification.

action: Add a rule to the IT explicitly stating that **glue or tape must be applied to the tube** when HSH is required, in line with the customer's requirement.

Analysis: three to four twists per meter (not explicitly stated in IT)
action: Add explicit mention of 'three to four twists per meter' in the IT to fully comply.

title: Conflict: DLW25046 p.11 vs WI 3600-11
detail:

IT: Quando requerido na tabua de montagem, componentes a aplicar por cima da manga (clips, abraçadeiras ou marcações de cor), é mandatório aplicar uma bandagem por baixo destes, estendendo a bandagem 10 a 15mm para cada lado.
Analysis: Specific element: 'spot tape applied at 150 mm intervals' (the requirement’s exact parameter).
action: Update the IT to explicitly include applying spot tape at 150 mm intervals to ensure full compliance with the customer requirement.

IT: Nota: […] Quando requerido na tabua de montagem, componentes a aplicar por cima da manga (clips, abraçadeiras ou marcações de cor), é mandatório aplicar uma bandagem por baixo destes, estendendo a bandagem 10 a 15mm para cada lado.
Analysis: number of wraps (two)
action: Verify if IT explicitly states 'two wraps' or revise to match requirement.

title: IT WI 3600-11 does not fully cover a requirement of DLW25046 p.11

IT: Nota: […] Quando requerido na tabua de montagem, componentes a aplicar por cima da manga (clips, abraçadeiras ou marcações de cor), é mandatório aplicar uma bandagem por baixo destes, estendendo a bandagem 10 a 15mm para cada lado.
Analysis: number of wraps (two)
action: update IT to explicitly state 'two wraps' under marker tape location

title: Conflict: DLW25046 p.11 vs WI 3600-11
detail:
Requirement: The supplier must ensure that the tag end of tape wraps on itself, not on the self-wrapping sleeve.
IT: [not verbatim] Bandage sleeve ends to secure wires inside (IT rule) contradicts 'tag end wraps on itself, not on sleeve' (customer requirement).
Analysis: The IT governs the installation of self-wrapping sleeves (same_activity). The requirement specifies the tag end must wrap on itself, not the sleeve. The IT mandates securing sleeve ends with bandages and keeping wires inside the sleeve, which could imply wrapping around the sleeve rather than allowing the tag end to wrap on itself. This directly contradicts the customer's explicit instruction. The IT does not mention the tag end's behavior, only sleeve securing methods. Thus, the IT's rules conflict with the requirement.
action: Revise IT to explicitly allow tag end wrapping on itself while ensuring sleeve securing methods do not interfere. Add clarification that bandaging is for securing, not for wrapping the tag end.

action: The IT needs to explicitly state that two layers of textile tape must be applied at the end of a branch, as required by the customer. Update the relevant section (e.g., 4.1.1 or 4.1.2) to include this specific detail.

title: Conflict: JDS-G223 p.26 vs WI 3359-11

Analysis: The IT governs the identification and marking of special characteristics in documents like FMEA and control plans, requiring symbols for process special characteristics. The IT's rules (e.g., 'symbol is indicated in FMEA column') directly contradict this by mandating symbols for such cases.
